How this works

Memory is an Obsidian vault the agent reads and writes, one fact per note. A digest of each chat lands here on its own.

Open a chat or pick a folder on Home. That folder is the repo.

How this works
Paste a key for one of OpenCode's own providers, such as OpenRouter or Anthropic, and its models show up in the picker. Or add your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the model ids you type. Saving reloads OpenCode, and running chats keep going.
